title: Reversed notes play backwards in the set
description:
As a producer, I want reversed notes to play backwards in the set, so that a reverse flip sounds the same.

```gherkin
Feature: Reversed notes
  Scenario: A reversed track plays its notes backwards
    Given the track "brk" plays its clip with "reverse"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then every clip of "brk" plays its audio backwards
    And each clip still starts and ends where the compiled note does

  Scenario: The same sample forwards and backwards
    Given the track "a" plays "brk.wav" forwards and the track "b" plays it with "reverse"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the clips of "a" play forwards and the clips of "b" play backwards

  Scenario: Reversed audio travels with the set even when samples are referenced in place
    Given the track "brk" plays its clip with "reverse"
    When I export the score as a DAW set with "--no-collect"
    Then every audio file the set refers to exists
```

Note: whether the set holds a reversed copy of the audio or the DAW's own reverse setting is decided in M0; the scenarios describe what the listener gets either way.
